state_source: preset/tone/motion/volume; active renderer clock; native scroll progress. Audio and shape derive from the same preset.

composition.desktop: Hero words/CTA left, sculpture right. Instrument heading and control panel left, sticky sculpture right. Both slots have approximately the same width/height.
composition.vertical: At <=900px, hero words/description/CTA all precede the large stage. Instrument begins with the sticky stage; heading/control column starts24px below the stage in natural flow.
composition.initialization: Both stage slots reserve flow from initial HTML; fixed host appears after actual placement. No js-active-dependent flow toggle.
composition.focus: Vertical root scroll-padding is stage height+24; instrument anchor has compensating negative stage scroll-margin; fields/buttons have12px top and24px bottom scroll-margin.

native_scroll.placement: lerp actual hero/instrument slot rects directly; no small corridor or discrete detour
native_scroll.stage_size: Same stage-height and nearby full widths at both endpoints; no intentional shrink at intermediate progress
native_scroll.geometry: Three original layers unfold: binormal offset*(layer-1)*0.52, depth offset*(layer-1)*0.42; layer rotations add0.23/0.28rad and twist loosens by18%. Finite-difference normals derive from the same surface.
native_scroll.reading_protection: PC keeps artwork entirely in the right column; vertical layout reserves the entire preview before text/controls
native_scroll.toolbar: Preset/pause buttons live inside host below the render-area and move with the same stage; no floating large index labels
native_scroll.reverse: same native progress and same geometry
native_scroll.reduced_or_paused: snap to nearest original/full-size slot; no animated travel
native_scroll.builder_verification: 24029 assertions using actual placeSculpture with synthetic rects plus analytic contain fit; not real browser layout verification

pause.raf: one pending/explicit input frame then no continuous RAF

visibility.hidden: cancel graphics RAF; cancel pending audio resume by generation; stop/dispose audio; no automatic sound restart
visibility.pagehide: also clear UI timer, cancel pending placement frame, invalidate offline/export/import results
visibility.pageshow: Restore timer/audio UI/graphics without autoplay, then next RAF synchronizes canonical JS state through updateLabels/updateMotionUI/setAudioUI/graphics. New document keeps initial state; bfcache keeps existing closure state. pagehide cancels pending form-sync RAF.

resize.canvas: slot bounds with fixed maximum-slot drawing buffer; DPR <=1.6 desktop /1.35 phone
resize.mesh: mobile segments selected on initial load

fallback.no_webgl: original preset-specific SVG + functional sound controls

diagnostics.performance: 20-second actual active frame intervals, LCP and max-session CLS; unsupported=null
diagnostics.layout_shift_sources: Raw max-session CLS unchanged; up to20 source entries with prior/current rectangles and recent-input flag.

evidence_frames_required: large open structure at p0/.25/.5/.65/.75/1 and reverse
vertical focus visible below sticky preview
History navigation after imported Halo64/72/18: slider/output/preset state all match after pageshow; audio stays stopped; saved settings retained

projection.limit: Sampled parameter states are not every possible browser/GPU/frame.
